  fiscal_period_label

  MAX(fiscal_year) AS latest_fiscal_year
FROM dim_date

  fc.period_end_date
FROM ref_fiscal_calendar fc

  AND fc.fiscal_period = 2

SELECT 
  ds.store_id,
  ds.store_name,
  ds.region,
  ds.format,
  SUM(dsr.receipts) AS receipts,
  SUM(dsr.units_sold) AS units_sold,
  SUM(dsr.net_sales) AS net_sales_eur,
  ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(dsr.net_sales) DESC) AS rank
FROM rpt_daily_store_sales dsr
INNER JOIN dim_store ds ON dsr.store_id = ds.store_id AND ds.is_current = true
WHERE dsr.business_date >= '2026-06-01' 
  AND dsr.business_date <= '2026-06-28'
GROUP BY ds.store_id, ds.store_name, ds.region, ds.format
ORDER BY net_sales_eur DESC

SELECT

  ds.region,
  ds.format,
  SUM(dsr.receipts) AS receipts,
  SUM(dsr.units_sold) AS units_sold,
  SUM(dsr.net_sales) AS net_sales_eur,

  AND dsr.business_date <= '2026-06-28'
